description: This file implements tracing utilities for the etcd project, including structures and methods for creating, managing, and logging traces and steps, with support for sub-traces and detailed step timing.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Represents a tracing context with steps, fields, and timing information.

classes.name: step
classes.description: Represents an individual step within a trace, including timing, message, and fields.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Key-value pair for recording additional trace details.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Trace instance with specified operation name, logger, and optional fields.

methods.name: TODO
methods.description: Returns a non-nil, empty Trace object.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the Trace object from a context.

methods.name: GetStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the trace.

methods.name: SetStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the trace.

methods.name: InsertStep
methods.description: Inserts a step at a specified index in the trace.

methods.name: StartSubTrace
methods.description: Marks the start of a sub-trace with optional fields.

methods.name: StopSubTrace
methods.description: Marks the end of a sub-trace with optional fields.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Adds a step with a message and optional fields.

methods.name: StepWithFunction
methods.description: Measures a function as a single step with a message and optional fields.

methods.name: AddField
methods.description: Adds or updates a field in the trace.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trace is empty.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs all steps in the trace.

methods.name: LogIfLong
methods.description: Logs the trace if duration exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: LogAllStepsIfLong
methods.description: Logs all steps if duration exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: LogWithStepThreshold
methods.description: Logs steps exceeding a specified duration threshold.

methods.name: logInfo
methods.description: Generates log message and fields for the trace.

methods.name: updateFieldIfExist
methods.description: Updates a field if it exists in the trace.

methods.name: disableStep
methods.description: Disables adding steps to the trace.

methods.name: enableStep
methods.description: Enables adding steps to the trace.
